definitions.withSteps: Device/component records with at least one explicitly linked fabrication step. Shared recipes count for each applicable record.
definitions.withProcessParameters: Records with at least one structured process parameter, including equipment and other process details.
definitions.withProcessConditions: Records with a reported structured process parameter other than equipment or process_other (time, temperature, pressure, chemistry, rate, angle, etc.). Narrative-only conditions are not inferred.
definitions.numeric: Converted finite point quantities only, retaining canonical units; bounds, ranges and reported-only quantities are omitted. A record can have several distinct values.
definitions.review: Flags are per PDF segment, inherited by its device records; flag counts are not independent device errors.
